subject: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination

Team,

We need to align on deprecating api-model-v1 (internal id: redwood-model-v1) and the customer migration plan. Proposed timeline in the attached spreadsheet: public announcement the week of 2026-04-06, 60-day notice for general hosted customers, and sunset on 2026-05-31.

Before we announce, I need clarity on the following:
- Technical migration effort and any breaking changes Dev expects (SDK, headers, inference behavior).
- Commitments or exceptions for Dedicated / Reserved customers and how Legal wants to handle contract amendments.
- Customer comms cadence and who leads outreach for high-touch accounts.
- Support runbooks and rollback options during the migration window.

Attachments: migration_timeline.xlsx (first pass), draft_customer_notice.md (starter copy).

Please reply with constraints, rough estimates, and any mandatory blockers by EOD Wed so I can consolidate and propose an announcement plan on Thu.

Thanks—
Hannah
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination

Thanks for the heads-up, Hannah. Technical notes:
- api-model-v1 -> api-model-v2 changes: tokenization differences are minimal, but attention-kernel reorder changes could change latency profiles at long sequence lengths. No API surface removal if we keep the compatibility shim, but shim costs memory and adds cpu overhead.
- Migration work: update SDK to expose new model param and deprecation header, add compatibility mode for two months. Rough estimate: 6 weeks of dev work + 2 weeks of integration + 1 week of internal canary/testing under load. That's without urgent bugfixes.
- Ops: will need a controlled rollout (canary tenants -> staged percentage ramp) to monitor perf regressions. We need feature-flag support in serving to route tenants to v1 vs v2 for grace period.
- Fallback: we can implement automatic fallback to the nearest compatible variant, but it requires KV cache compatibility testing.

Attaching dev_notes.md with more granular tasks and the list of affected runtimes. Blocking items: final API contract for the compatibility header, and confirmation of the launch freeze window for runtime changes.

-- Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination

Hannah — important sales perspective:
- Top customers who will push back: Acme Analytics (Emma Jones), Delta Analytics, HealthSys. Several of these have reserved capacity or long-standing SOWs; they typically ask for 90+ days for migrations.
- We need a standard exemption/extension process (legal-approved amendment) and a templated migration SOW we can add for Dedicated customers.
- Recommend we: (1) announce to hosted customers with a 60-day standard window, (2) proactively reach out to Dedicated/Reserved accounts with 90-day migration offers and a migration playbook + optional paid migration support.
- I can draft outreach cadence (email + follow-up call + migration workshop). Need the prioritized account list and a migration timeline matrix so AE/AMs can commit dates.

Please include in the announcement: a migration FAQ and links to SDK updates + migration guide. I can own the customer notice and initial outreach if Legal signs off on the amendment template.

Laura
Account Executive, East Coast
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination

Quick legal/ops notes:
- For customers on reserved/dedicated contracts, we cannot unilaterally change the service that materially affects SLAs without an amendment. We should prepare a simple amendment template (attached) that: confirms timeline, defines migration support scope, and preserves committed throughput until migration is complete.
- For hosted customers (pay-as-you-go), standard 60-day notice is acceptable provided the SDK and migration docs are available at announcement time.
- Please send me the list of Dedicated/Private customers and the specific contract IDs; Legal will prioritize amendments for those accounts.
- Risk assessment: classify accounts by "reserved capacity" and "regulated" (health/finance) — regulated accounts will require coordination with Security for added QA.

Attachment: template_amendment.docx

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Legal Operations
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination

Operational plan items from Support/CS perspective:
- Create a migration runbook for engineers and CS: pre-checklist, dry-run checklist, post-migration validation, rollback steps. I'll draft migration_runbook.md and share the runbook in the migration tracker.
- Propose weekly migration office hours during the 60/90-day windows and a dedicated Slack channel for live escalation.
- We should prepare a small migration toolkit (scripts + validation tests) that AE/AMs can run with customers; this reduces high-touch hours.
- For high-risk accounts (Acme, HealthSys), propose we schedule migration workshops with an engineer and CS owner present.

I'll create the tracker (sheet link below) and begin populating with account owners and proposed migration dates.

Jonas
Customer Success Manager
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned deprecation: api-model-v1 — migration coordination

Thanks, all — here's the consolidated plan and owners: 
- Announcement cadence: Hosted customers get 60-day public notice (announce 2026-04-06). Dedicated/Reserved customers get 90-day tailored outreach. Laura owns customer comms.
- Technical work (Dev): compatibility shim + SDK updates, feature-flagged rollout, canary testing. Dev to share a milestone plan by 2026-03-20.
- Legal (Marissa): prepare amendment template for Dedicated customers and review high-risk contracts. Legal to flag any customers that need extra time by 2026-03-18.
- CS/Support (Jonas): migration runbook, office hours, and migration toolkit. Jonas to create tracker and schedule first office hours week of 2026-03-22.
- Announcement assets: migration FAQ, migration guide, sample notice, and SDK changelog — draft links below. Laura will own the outbound.
- Exceptions: any exception must be a signed amendment; for one-off emergency extensions we will treat on a case-by-case basis and log in the migration tracker.

Next steps:
1) Dev: upload milestone plan and dev_notes.md to the tracker by 2026-03-20.
2) Marissa: send cohort of contract IDs for Legal prioritization by 2026-03-18.
3) Laura: finalize draft_customer_notice.md and send to Emma Jones at Acme and other top accounts after Legal sign-off.
4) Jonas: publish migration_runbook.md and schedule office hours; share tracker link.

Links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-migration-tracker (tracker), https://drive.redwood.ai/docs/draft_customer_notice (notice draft)

I'll prepare the public announcement copy after we validate the dev milestone plan. If there are objections to the 60/90-day split, speak up now.

— Hannah
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
